resolution_rules_applied: There is no 'Pending Whitelisting' concept: every office with at least one device is eligible for activation analysis.
'Device Not Supplied' is derived as Master minus Device Supply — not sourced from any separate maintained list.
An Office ID on the device list that is NOT in the current Master has its device(s) excluded from every total ('orphaned') rather than silently guessed at.
